key_terms.عِبَادِي: My servants (plural of 'abd, referring to devoted worshippers)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Enter among My servants' in Surah Al-Fajr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this command 'Enter among My servants' is frequently interpreted as the culmination of the soul's journey, marking the transition from the barzakh (intermediate state) to the presence of the Divine. It underscores the concept of 'wilayah' and the special status of the faithful who are recognized as Allah's chosen servants, often linked with the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt. This verse serves as a comforting promise for the believers on the Day of Judgment, affirming their inclusion in the divine circle of intimacy.
